title: Perfekt (past tense with haben)
description: Learn about Perfekt (past tense with haben) in German.
explanation: The Perfekt tense is used for spoken past in German. It is formed with a helping verb (haben/sein) and the Partizip II at the end of the sentence.

exercises.question: Was ___ du gestern gemacht?
exercises.explanation: Mach uses haben, conjugated for du.
